artist_notes.name: Buchecha
artist_notes.note: Hard techno/schranz name; a recent LA debut was billed at a TBA DTLA warehouse party.

curator_note: Cheap late-start DTLA warehouse night with a surprise guest slot. Buchecha leans hard, so go if you want a harder, sweatier night than the usual groove.
description: Late-night DTLA warehouse party headlined by Buchecha with an unannounced guest.

artist_notes.name: DINABN
artist_notes.note: LA DJ tied to the Club Cielo Latin American underground femme collective.

curator_note: Small Silver Lake room, a ten-minute hop from home, and free with RSVP. It's a low-stakes local bill, so treat it as a wander-in night and not a destination.
description: Club Cielo's underground dance night at El Cid with DINABN, Asphodèle and MARCHANTE.

curator_note: Dansyn and Kamjam at Sound is a straight-ahead Hollywood house night. The ticket is a bit steep for a bill with no clear hook, so it's a maybe.
description: House night with Dansyn and Kamjam at Sound Nightclub in Hollywood.

artist_notes.name: Deorro
artist_notes.note: LA-raised big-room house producer, now doing Latin club and regional Mexican crossovers.

curator_note: Deorro's regional-Mexican-meets-rave concept at Grand Park is a big, loud daytime party. It's closer to a fiesta than a club night and the ticket price reflects that, so it's one for the crowd and not for the groove.
description: Outdoor Insomniac show at Grand Park with Deorro's Botas Y Rave concept, from 5pm.

curator_note: An afterhours at the Lexington with no lineup posted yet. Worth watching for a late announcement, but there's nothing to commit to now.
description: Late-night afterhours party at The Lexington in DTLA starting 11pm.
